blurb: Welcome To Tsillan Cellars We are proud to produce estate wines along with wines sourced from some of Washington's best growing regions. Our estate grapes are grown in our vineyards located on the South Shore of Lake Chelan. This is the same property as our estate winery, tasting room and Sorrento's Ristorante.
